reason: Ruby receiver becomes the first TS argument: the method is a Ruby instance method on a core class, ported as a standalone function (or a JS built-in) whose leading parameter is `self`.
Equivalent: `@codecs.any?` over a Hash is `this.#codecs.size > 0` on a Map, which has no `any?`.
Equivalent: JS arrays have no `clear`; the rotate-options array is emptied by assignment instead.
No JS analogue: Ruby filter_maps `Method#parameters` for the generator's keyword names; TS has no parameter reflection, so a generator declares them on `parameters`.
